S&P 500 Up 13% Six Months Into Iran War, and History Says That's Normal [...] ## S&P 500

The S&P 500 is a benchmark stock market index that measures the performance of 500 large-cap companies listed on U.S. exchanges. Created in 1957 by Standard & Poor's, it covers a diverse range of sectors and is considered a key indicator of overall market health. Investors and analysts use the S&P 500 to track economic trends, assess portfolio performance, and gauge investor sentiment in the U.S. equity market.

Stock Market: Will S&P 500 Open Up or Down Today?

U.S. stock futures are trending higher early Monday as Wall Street weighs resilience in equities against a backdrop of surging Treasury yields and escalating Middle East tensions.

The Polymarket (CRYPTO: POL) crowd is leaning bearish for the Sept. 28 trading session. The “S&P 500 (SPX) Up or Down on September 28?” contract currently reflects a 28% chance of a higher open.

## Why That Number Matters [...] Traders are balancing strong corporate earnings and tech optimism against severe geopolitical friction and high borrowing costs:

 Positive Index Futures: Equity futures are pointing to a mostly green open, with tech and blue-chip stocks leading. At the last check, Dow Jones futures rose 0.86% and S&P 500 futures advanced 0.47%. Nasdaq 100 futures gained 0.40%, while Russell 2000 futures bucked the trend, slipping 0.55%.

Ad [...] The Sept. 25 Polymarket contract resolved “Up.” The contract recorded $76,202 in total trading volume.

On Friday, the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (NYSE:SPY) and Invesco QQQ Trust ETF (NASDAQ:QQQ), which track the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100, respectively, closed higher. SPY rose 0.54% to $771.35, while QQQ gained 0.46% to $744.50. Meanwhile, the Dow tracker, State Street SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF Trust (NYSE:DIA), ended 0.94% higher at $517.49.
